blurb: Guests participate in hot yoga classes heated to 95-100 degrees with various styles including Level 1, All Levels Flow, Yin, Barkan method, Power Vinyasa, Gentle flow, and restorative yoga with massage. Additional services include massage therapy sessions, infrared sauna sessions, and cold plunge therapy. The studio features modern amenities such as cork flooring, infrared heating, and rental yoga mats and towels.
